messages:
maria: quick heads-up: found a reproducible bundler+edge runtime issue when a workspace package exposes both an ESM import and a CJS default in exports and is symlinked. repro attached.

maria: Setup: monorepo (pnpm workspace) with apps/web and packages/ui-component. ui-component has "type": "module" and exports: import -> dist/index.mjs, default -> dist/index.cjs.js.

maria: App imports: `import { Icon } from 'ui-component'` and we build for edge (vite w/ our edge plugin). Start dev server -> runtime error: `TypeError: require is not defined`.

jun: does it happen only for symlinked workspace packages or for published packages too?

maria: only symlinked. Published package resolves correctly to the ESM import entry.

rachel: stackpoints to a vendor chunk with a CJS wrapper: `.cache/vite/deps/vendor-ui-component.js` containing `var require = ...` style shims. Edge runtime has no require, so it blows up.

maria: snippet of ui-component package.json:
```
{
  "name": "ui-component",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "default": "./dist/index.cjs.js" }
  }
}
```

leo: bundlers sometimes choose the default/cjs fallback for file: or linked deps for dedupe/interop reasons. If resolver picks the cjs path for workspace symlinks, edge breaks.

rachel: tried configuring resolve fields (webpack resolve.mainFields, vite optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions.mainFields) but symlinked package still preferred CJS.

jun: quick workaround: remove the CJS fallback for workspace packages or publish a snapshot package. Not ideal but unblocks.

leo: long-term options: 1) make our edge bundler plugin detect symlinked/workspace deps and force `exports.import` resolution; 2) emit a clear warning when a linked package exposes a CJS fallback; 3) add CI matrix tests for bundlers + workspace vs published.

maria: uploaded small repro: https://internal.redwood/repros/workspace-symlink-edge-2965001234.tar.gz and opened draft PR with a resolve plugin patch.

ci-bot: build: CI job #5012 started for branch maria/edge-symlink-fix.

jun: thanks. please add tests for vite/rollup/webpack + symlink/published matrix so we catch regressions.

maria: will do and add a docs note in monorepo onboarding: "avoid CJS fallback for workspace packages targeting edge runtimes". ping me for review.

rachel: :thumbsup: saved a customer ticket earlier today. good catch.
maria: thanks everyone.
